AUTHOR: Bilodeau, SM; Schwartz, AWH; Xu, BF; Pauca, VP; Silman, MR
TITLE: A low-cost, long-term underwater camera trap network coupled with deep residual learning image analysis
SPECIES: Fish vs NoFish image classification (reef fishes)
DATA: Own DEAC time-lapse camera-trap images, 21 patch-reef sites, 2018-2019 (130,621 collected, 88,899 usable); Harvard Dataverse
V_EV: Results, Biofouling: 'camera function was also limited by reduced visibility at certain sites, which varied based on local turbidity and light availability, and by depth.'
D2: 10,727 training / 2,702 validation images (human-sorted); applied to 75,470 further images
D_EV: Methods, Training and validation: 'Our model was trained on a sample of 10,727 images... validated by comparing... with the actual... designations assigned to 2,702 images hand-sorted'
R_EV: Results: 'The model was trained on 10,727 images classified by volunteers and then validated with an additional 2,702 human-sorted images' (single campaign/dataset)
C_EV: Methods: 'The model's accuracy was validated by comparing the categories produced by sorting above and below 0.5 probability'
E_EV: Methods, Image analysis: 'Images with a "Fish" probability of 0.5 or above were used to determine the relative presence of fishes at camera sites inside and outside of the Half Moon Caye MPA'
ARCH: ResNet-50 binary classifier with focal loss
NOTE: Split given only as image counts from time-lapse camera sequences with no grouping statement -> coded 이미지/프레임 무작위 by analogy to the frames-from-videos rule (could arguably be NR). Diver-survey comparison (NMDS) used human identification of 54 images, not CNN output, so E5=없음 for the AI output. E1: CNN-derived proportion of images with fish compared across habitat/MPA and time (Fig 7); coded 점유 (also time series; 복수 arguable). Biofouling-related degradation of model shown only qualitatively (S2-S4 Figs); not water-visibility stratification. Table 1 gives Fish-class miss count (165/609) but no explicit FNR analysis -> E4=없음.
